facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Focus: Software / deep tech / hardware / robotics / science / unconventional projects
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Minimum US$1K no-strings-attached stipend; potential later 1517 venture investment if project becomes startup
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity, no IP rights on Medici grant
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 面向 high school、college students、dropouts；项目必须出于自主创作而非学校成绩/申请；强调强烈 personal obsession / maker drive。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 已经在 build；有具体实验/原型；能清楚说明为什么非做不可；愿意用小额 grant 快速推进。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 无固定 cohort residency；以 grant + mentorship/community 为主。
facts_raw.International Founder: Mentorship/community can be global; cash grants limited
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 无需 relocation。官方明确因国际法规，无法向 North America 以外团队发放 grant，但欢迎联系，支持能力会有限。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 向 1517 团队发一段约5分钟 Loom video，介绍自己、为什么痴迷该项目、grant 如何帮助推进。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官网明确可给团队成员发 firstname@1517fund.com，并附5分钟 Loom；公开 general email 为 info@1517fund.com。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: High school / college / dropout 的年轻 maker；science、tech、math、arts、robotics、energy 等自驱项目；可尚未成立 startup。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 成熟公司；只是为了参加项目/升学而做的 school project；年龄/身份明显脱离年轻 maker 群体；北美之外只期待现金 grant。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：这是 youth-maker grant，不应和标准 startup accelerator 混为一谈；对中国 founder 若人/项目不在北美，不能期待拿到 grant。

facts.Focus: Software / deep tech / hardware / robotics / science / unconventional projects
facts.Funding / Support: Minimum US$1K no-strings-attached stipend; potential later 1517 venture investment if project becomes startup
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity, no IP rights on Medici grant
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: High-school or college students and people who have left formal education. Projects must be self-directed rather than pursued for grades or admissions, with strong personal motivation.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Already building experiments or prototypes, able to explain the motivation and use a small grant to advance quickly.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No fixed cohort residency; primarily grant support, mentorship and community.
facts.International Founder: Mentorship/community can be global; cash grants limited
facts.Visa / Relocation: No relocation required. International regulations prevent grants to teams outside North America; contact is welcome, but support may be limited.
facts.Application Materials: Send the 1517 team an approximately five-minute Loom video introducing yourself, your commitment to the project and how the grant would help.
facts.Public Contact Route: The website permits contact at firstname@1517fund.com with a five-minute Loom video. General email: info@1517fund.com.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Young, self-directed makers in high school, college or outside formal education, working in science, technology, mathematics, arts, robotics or energy. Incorporation is not required.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature companies, school projects pursued only for grades or admissions, applicants outside the young-maker profile, or applicants outside North America seeking only a cash grant.
facts.Notes: A youth-maker grant rather than a standard accelerator. Applicants and projects outside North America should not expect grant funding.
